title: Shared-prefix causal-tree repair for down-projection full-K refresh timing
scientific_question: Does the production down-projection full-K refresh causally produce the post-refresh short-horizon degradation observed for original Newton-Muon in MECH-08?

protocol_amendment.repair_principle: Replace independent pre-treatment trajectories with exact shared-prefix forks and add an internal production arm; do not relax thresholds, tune hyperparameters, select units, or use post-treatment outcomes to design the repair.
protocol_amendment.legacy_results_policy: Retain as invalid_pre_intervention_equivalence diagnostics only; exclude from confirmatory mechanism claims.

restart_intervention.model_parameters: copied exactly from the origin checkpoint
restart_intervention.backup_adamw_state: loaded exactly from the origin checkpoint
restart_intervention.matrix_momentum: copied exactly by matrix-parameter order from the origin checkpoint
restart_intervention.candidate_preconditioner_state: freshly initialized and built from the same frozen validation split used by MECH-08 before optimizer step 1
restart_intervention.learning_rate_schedule: constant nominal production peak learning rates for the full rollout

shared_policy.skipped_statistics_policy: zero accumulated down-projection activation statistics at each skipped refresh boundary without changing its covariance or inverse
shared_policy.branch_snapshot: exact CPU clone of model, both optimizer state_dict objects, next training batch, loader state, RNG states, and matrix global step
shared_policy.restore_audit: fixed-sample SHA256 over every named model/optimizer tensor plus exact next-batch hashes, loader state, matrix global step, and zero activation-statistic checks

comparison_contract.paired_unit: checkpoint origin x data-order replica inside one shared-prefix worker
comparison_contract.negative_delta_means: left arm has lower held-out loss and is better

full_support_rules: all three arms are exactly identical at step 16 because they share one computed prefix
delayed and frozen arms are exactly identical at step 48 because they share one no-down-refresh branch through step 63
delayed and frozen each beat internal production at step 48 in at least 9 of 12 paired units and 3 of 4 origin means
after delayed refreshes at step 64, delayed is worse than frozen at step 80 in at least 9 of 12 paired units and 3 of 4 origin means
analysis_contract.partial_support_rule: execution integrity and both exact shared-prefix checks pass, with at least two but not all three directional predictions passing
analysis_contract.not_supported_rule: execution integrity and both exact shared-prefix checks pass, with fewer than two directional predictions passing
analysis_contract.invalid_rule: execution integrity or either exact shared-prefix check fails

authorized: causal manipulation of down-projection full-K refresh timing only
an internal production arm forked from the exact same state
held-out evaluation on the frozen MECH-08 validation windows
not_authorized: using post-treatment results from the invalid independent-worker run to alter predictions or thresholds
changing learning rates, ridge, beta, momentum, data order, checkpoint selection, or non-target refresh timing
treating Selective-diag versus Selective-none as a primary comparison
using worker timing or CUDA allocation as paper efficiency evidence
